gaps.sentence: The ___ (POPULAR) of the band grew after the film.
He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the best ___ (SCIENCE) in the field.
gaps.hint: plural person needed after 'one of the best'
gaps.explanation: 'One of the best' is followed by a plural noun for people: scientists.

gaps.sentence: The firefighter was given a medal for her ___ (HERO).
gaps.explanation: 'Her heroism' — the quality noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The referee sent him off for repeated ___ (OBEY).
gaps.explanation: 'Repeated disobedience' — the negative noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The airline is known for its excellent ___ (SERVE).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'excellent'; note the spelling change
gaps.explanation: The noun of 'serve' is 'service' (-ice); a servant is a person who serves.

gaps.sentence: He denied all knowledge of the ___ (APPEAR) of the documents.
gaps.explanation: The documents vanished, so the negative noun 'disappearance' is needed; 'appearance' means coming into view.

gaps.sentence: We must ___ our efforts to finish on time (STRONG).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -en forms the verb: strengthen. A base verb follows 'must'.
